searchText: agree if it's part of a stable release but do you mean the new gloas events specifically? I don't think we should freeze the spec there yet, we can do breaking changes across devnets easily without requiring a v2 all apis that are versioned (via fork) have a `version` field in the json response and the `Eth-Consensus-Version` header, there are 16 endpoints that have this pattern, eg. `getBlockV2`, `getProposerLookahead`, `getStateV2`, `produceBlockV3` to name a few We’re implementing events on master - so if the new code sends different data it’s going to break fulu clients if things they consume changes shape I’ll recheck the pool endpoints but they looked inconsistent I don't see how a gloas event can break fulu clients, we aren't even emitting those yet besides on devnet-0 Talking about modifying existing events but we aren't doing that? or which event specifically do you mean I can recheck, not at computer. I thought there were events we were adding to hmm not sure, if that's the case definitley agree, but also adding fields to an event shouldn't break client either way imo SignedProposerPreferences should replace /eth/v1/validator/prepare_beacon_proposer right? and `/eth/v1/validator/register_validator`, at least it would be nice to finally consolidate those two apis, was proposed a while ago here https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/435 makes sense to me 🙏
